def: a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild

occurrences.text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
